question: What essential truth is Pārvatī asking the great god Śaṅkara to reveal compassionately?
premises: An essential truth remains to be explained
Pārvatī addresses the great god Śaṅkara
She requests the teaching out of compassion
inference: Pārvatī seeks compassionate revelation of the decisive essential truth from Śaṅkara.
plain_english: O great god Śaṅkara, out of compassion speak this truth.
